_source.Study Protocol Description: TK6 cells were maintained in exponential growth at densities of 1-10 x 10^5 cells/ml in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated (56C for 45 minutes) fetal calf serum and 100 U/ml penicillin and 100 ug/ml streptomycin in a humidified, 5% CO2 atmosphere in a 37C incubator.     HZE particle irradiation was performed at the NASA Space Radiation Laboratory (NSRL) at Brookhaven National Laboratory. Exponentially growing cells were concentrated by centrifugation and exposed to graded doses of 1 GeV/amu 56Fe ions (150 keV/um) in a volume of 10 ml per culture point to limit the amount of medium activated during the irradiation. Dosimetry was performed by the NSRL Physics Group. Tubes containing the cells were placed perpendicular to the beam in the center of the field, where the variation in fluence was  less than 5%. Control cultures were prepared in the same way and mock irradiated. An activated-medium control was prepared by irradiating 10 ml of medium without cells to the highest dose used (2.5 Gy). Immediately after irradiation, medium was added to bring the cells to normal culture densities (4-5 x 10^5cells/ml). Gamma-ray irradiation was performed at Columbia University using an AECL Gammacell-40 137Cs irradiator with a dose rate of 1.1 Gy/min.     RNA was extracted using a modified guanidine thiocyanate method, (Chomczynski and Sacchi, 1987, PMID: 2440339) followed by purification with RNeasy columns (Qiagen, Valencia, CA). RNA samples were quantified using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer and monitored for quality using an Agilent Bioanalyzer prior to labeling for microarray analysis.     24 hours after treatment, fluorescently labeled cDNA was prepared from mock-irradiated control and irradiated whole-cell RNA by a single round of reverse transcription (BRL Superscript II) in the presence of aminoallyl dUTP (Sigma-Aldrich), followed by coupling to monofunctional NHS-ester Cy3 or Cy5 dye (Amersham) (Amundson and Fornace, 2004. PMID:14970650)     Hybridization was carried out with active mixing using the MAUI Hybridization System (BioMicro Systems, Salt Lake City, UT) for 16 hours in Deposition Hybridization Buffer (Agilent) at 65oC in the presence of the blockers human CoT1, yeast tRNA and poly dA. Hybridized slides were washed at room temperature once in 0.5X SSC, 0.01% SDS for 5 minutes and again in 0.06X SSC for 5 minutes.     Slides were scanned on an Agilent Microarray Scanner, 100% PMT voltage, 10 uM resolution scans. Images were processed using ArraySuite 2.1 extensions in the IPLab program (Scanalytics Inc., Fairfax, VA) as described in Chen et al., 2002 (PMID: 12217912).     ID_REF equals VALUE equals Mean red and green background subtracted intensities for each feature were adjusted using the ratio used by the ArraySuite program to calculate the calibrated ratio, and then imported into BRB Array Tools 3.7.0, log2 transformed and median-normalized. The summary table excludes features with intensity less than 250 or low overall ArraySuite quality metrics (Q less than 0.3).

_source.Study Description: Transcriptional profiling of human lymphoblastoid TK6 cells comparing mock irradiated cells with cells exposed 24 hours previously to 1.67 Gy HZE (1 GeV/amu iron ions accelerated at the NASA Space Research Laboratory (NSRL) of Brookhaven National Laboratory) or 2.5 Gy 137Cs gamma rays. TK6 cells were mock irradiated or exposed to HZE or gamma-rays, and RNA was harvested 24 hours later. 3 biological replicates were independently grown and harvested during three different runs at the NSRL. One replicate per array.
